Data science graduates have a plethora of career opportunities across various industries. They can become data scientists, analyzing complex data sets to solve business problems using statistical techniques and machine learning.
Alternatively, they can work as data analysts, interpreting and visualizing data for decision-making. Other paths include machine learning engineers, data engineers, business analysts, quantitative analysts in finance, research scientists in academia, data consultants, data product managers, and data science educators.
These opportunities span sectors such as pharma, technology, finance, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, consulting, academia, and more.
